hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/hickory-run-state-park/stay ('Many sites with electric; some full-hookup sites (sewer, water, electricity)') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880409 (111 Modern Electric and 15 Full-Hookup sites list 50-amp; the Full-Hookup sites list water and sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Listed max vehicle lengths on the booking site are mostly 15-20 ft; about 80 drive-in sites take 30 ft and about 28 take 40 ft (the longest, including Rattlesnake loop full-hookup sites). One pull-through (Bear loop site 012, full hookup, 40 ft); the rest are back-in.

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/hickory-run-state-park/stay ('Warm showers, Flush restrooms, Sanitary dump station, Camp store with supplies, ice, firewood, and food'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window). Pets on designated sites only. Bear country: food and scented items must be stored in the vehicle when away from the site.
